Hypothesis on the given map is strengthened/changed in kind: gold's ϕ : Mₚ →ₗ[R] Nₚ is only required to be R-linear between the (abstractly characterized) localized modules, whereas produced's h : LocalizedModule S M →ₗ[Localization S] LocalizedModule S N is required to be linear over the localized ring Localization S — a strictly stronger condition (Localization S-linear maps are a proper subclass of R-linear maps between the same modules), so the produced theorem covers a different, more restrictive class of input maps.
M and N are assumed only AddCommMonoid (produced) instead of AddCommGroup (gold), changing the hypothesis on the underlying algebraic structure.

No existential witness s : S (unit of localization) appears in the produced conclusion, unlike gold which requires such an s and an explicit equation involving it.
